package.archive_sha256_note: The original downloaded archive was not retained locally; no archive hash is claimed.

source_tree.canonicalization: Sort by case-sensitive filename; each UTF-8 line is filename, TAB, lowercase SHA-256, LF; include a final LF. This tree hash is independent of the sha256sum-formatted manifest file.

local_modification_policy: Official source files are not modified. The path-precedence initialization.m shim restores the configured RNG seed after official initialization.
